name: Alcaldía de Villavicencio
body: Structured data that names the city hall, full share cards, one-year HSTS, and a permanent https redirect. But the home page's <head> loads 15 scripts without async or defer, and the HTML alone weighs 549 KB.
lesson: Add defer to scripts that don't need to run before first paint, and move inline data out of the HTML.
summary: villavicencio.gov.co scores 73 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 6 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 6 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /municipio/calendario-de-eventos/, /municipio/directorio-de-agremiaciones/, /municipio/directorio-de-entidades/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 15 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 15 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 15 pages read.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 15 pages read.

fix.title: 15 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
